ideas.pitch: An AI-powered micro-grid load balancer leveraging multi-agent systems to dynamically shift local energy consumption based on real-time campus solar generation and weather patterns.
ideas.problem_statement: IoT & Smart Infrastructure domain open innovation challenge focusing on energy efficiency and smart campus infrastructure.
ideas.title: AuraGrid
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages an advanced multi-agent closed-loop operational pattern similar to SEAL Hackathon winners, standing out visually on a live leaderboard during technical reviews.

ideas.pitch: A low-cost edge-computing vital signs anomaly detector for remote health camps using ESP32 microcontrollers and lightweight machine learning models.
ideas.problem_statement: AI/ML and IoT open innovation challenge addressing rural healthcare access and real-time patient monitoring.
ideas.title: BioEdge Sentinel
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adopts the successful edge-computing hardware integration strategy seen at HardHack, proving tangible real-world medical utility during live demos.

ideas.pitch: A physical anti-counterfeiting verification system using conductive ink signatures scanned via custom ESP32 hardware to authenticate official university credentials and asset tags.
ideas.problem_statement: IoT & Smart Infrastructure and Open Innovation challenges focusing on security and supply chain integrity.
ideas.title: VeritasTag Campus
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the unique physical security build approach of Hack-4-Viksit Bharat winners, impressing judges with a tactile hardware-backed proof of authenticity.

ideas.pitch: An automated waste segregation rover prototype built with computer vision and Arduino microcontrollers to sort recyclable materials on campus in real time.
ideas.problem_statement: IoT & Smart Infrastructure open innovation challenge targeting sustainable waste management.
ideas.title: EcoSort AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines physical robotics with live AI classification, directly echoing the TechnoMorph Hackathon runner-up approach.

ideas.pitch: An edge AI industrial safety compliance monitor that detects missing personal protective equipment and triggers real-time alerts via local camera feeds.
ideas.problem_statement: AI/ML domain open innovation challenge focusing on workplace safety and automated monitoring.
ideas.title: SafeSite Vision
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fulfills the high-demand industrial safety category with a robust, low-latency vision pipeline that can be tested live during technical reviews.
